_comment: PROJECT-OWNED — `bun run up` never overwrites this file.
`tsconfig.base.json` is the synced half: compiler options and, above all,
the path aliases every synced file imports through. This file owns what is
genuinely the project's: which directories are type-checked.
Override any compiler option by redeclaring it under `compilerOptions`
here — `extends` merges that object key by key. `paths` is the exception:
redeclaring it replaces the base map wholesale, so copy the base map and
append rather than listing only the new alias.
